## Learning Objectives

Today, we will start with the ungraded quiz, then cover regular expressions (see last lecture). We will then go over the exam format and have a Q&A session.

In the second part of class, we will learn how to import and export data in R, and briefly introduce relational data.


## Before Class

- Download last lecture's class materials (if you haven't already) using the purple `usethis::` code at the top of [Lecture 8](08-home.qmd).
- Read the `regex.Rmd` tutorial and complete the practice exercises
- Bring any questions to class


## Readings

- Importing data: ["Chapter 7 Data import"](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/data-import.html) from "R for Data Science" 2nd Edition and [readr Documentation](https://readr.tidyverse.org/index.html)
- Relational data: ["Chapter 19 Joins"](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/joins) from "R for Data Science" 2nd Edition
